title: 第83章 瓮中捉“猴”
content_zh:
第83章 瓮中捉“猴”-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

顾承安切换到深度查询模块，输入号码，勾选“全量通信记录”、“绑定设备信息”、“基站定位历史”三个选项，提交查询。

数据刷出来了。

这个号码的通话记录不多，总共只有两条，时间集中在最近一个月内，全部是呼出，没有呼入——典型的一次性联络号码使用模式。

关键信息在设备绑定那一栏。

【使用设备记录：】

【1.iPhOne15，IMEI：3547……（使用时段：7月2日X时）】

【2.iPhOne15，IMEI：3547……（使用时段：7月19日X时）】

顾承安对照王强记忆视频里的通话时间——7月19日。

对上了。

他复制这部iPhOne15的IMEI码，进入设备追踪模块，查询该设备绑定过的所有SIM卡号码。

结果弹出四个号码。

前三个都是已断网状态，最后一个——状态显示“关机”。

关机，意味着这张卡现在还插在某部手机里。

顾承安查询这个在网号码的最新通信记录。

最后一条通话：今天，21:31分。呼出。通话时长：47秒。

今天晚上九点三十一分。

距离案发，刚好一个小时出头。

顾承安的眼睛眯了起来。

案发后一小时，瘦猴还在用这部手机打电话。

要么是他还没反应过来要换设备，要么是他手头暂时没有备用机——不管哪种，这都是一个致命的疏忽。

顾承安立刻调取这条通话记录对应的基站信息。

【接入基站：鹏城市龙华区民治街道XX基站】

【覆盖范围：以基站为圆心，半径约800米区域】

龙华区，民治街道。

顾承安脑子里自动调出这片区域的基本情况——老旧城中村密集，握手楼成片，巷道狭窄曲折，外来务工人员聚居，人员流动性极大，监控覆盖率在全市属于垫底水平。

是个藏人的好地方。

顾承安看着屏幕上那个红色圆圈覆盖的区域，嘴角微微上扬。

瘦猴啊瘦猴，你躲得确实不错，选的地方也够刁钻，搁一般的刑侦手段，可能真让你耗个十天半月再溜出去。

可惜。

你遇到的不是一般人。

Gu Chengan switched to the in-depth query module, entered the number, checked the three options of "Full Communication Records", "Bound Device Information", and "Base Station Positioning History" and submitted the query.

The data is flushed.

There are not many call records for this number. There are only two calls in total. The times are concentrated in the past month. All calls are outgoing and there are no incoming calls - a typical usage pattern of disposable contact numbers.

The key information is in the device binding column.

[Usage equipment record:]

[1.iPhOne15, IMEI: 3547... (Usage period: X hour on July 2)]

[2.iPhOne15, IMEI: 3547... (Usage period: X hour on July 19)]

Gu Chengan compared the call time in Wang Qiang's memory video - July 19.

Right.

He copied the IMEI code of the iPhOne15, entered the device tracking module, and checked all SIM card numbers bound to the device.

Four numbers popped up.

The first three are disconnected from the Internet, and the last one-the status shows "Shutdown".

Shutting down the phone means that the card is still inserted into a certain mobile phone.

Gu Chengan checked the latest communication records of this online number.

Last call: Today, 21:31.exhale.Call duration: 47 seconds.

It's 9:31 this evening.

It was just over an hour before the incident occurred.

Gu Chengan's eyes narrowed.

An hour after the incident, Shouhou was still using this mobile phone to make calls.

Either he hadn't reacted yet and needed to change the device, or he didn't have a spare machine on hand at the moment - either way, this was a fatal oversight.

Gu Chengan immediately retrieved the base station information corresponding to this call record.

[Access base station: XX base station, Minzhi Street, Longhua District, Pengcheng City]

[Coverage: With the base station as the center, a radius of about 800 meters]

Longhua District, Minzhi Street.

Gu Chengan automatically recalled the basic situation of this area in his mind - dense villages in the old city, clusters of handshake buildings, narrow and winding lanes, migrant workers living together, great mobility of people, and the surveillance coverage rate is at the bottom of the city.

It's a good place to hide people.

Gu Chengan looked at the area covered by the red circle on the screen and raised the corners of his mouth slightly.

Slim Monkey, Slim Monkey, you hid really well, and the place you chose was tricky enough. Using ordinary criminal investigation methods, it might really take you ten and a half days to sneak out.

pity.

You are not meeting ordinary people.
